independent_review_findings.title: Action Hero caches an effective critical chance and writes it as a raw item value, conflicting with weapon-trait writers
independent_review_findings.reproduction_evidence: For a sharp weapon, getCriticalChance returns raw critical chance multiplied by sharpness, but setCriticalChance writes raw. Action Hero then competes with Axes/Cleaver absolute writers; last writer wins and transitions can strand a bonus.
independent_review_findings.missing_proof: Save/load persistence of the raw Java field was not observed in game; same-world item handoff and non-composition are statically proven.
independent_review_findings.recommended_correction: Replace independent absolute setters with one per-source aggregate or calculate bonuses at hit time; restore on swap, drop, transfer, and trait loss.
independent_review_findings.smallest_regression_test: Use a sharp weapon with Action Hero plus Axes/Cleaver, toggle each effect, swap and transfer the item, and assert additive composition and exact base restoration.

independent_review_findings.title: Shared consumption hooks stack on repeated OnGameStart
independent_review_findings.reproduction_evidence: Each OnGameStart captures the already wrapped perform method and wraps it again without a sentinel, causing duplicated wrapper layers and global timed-action mutation; the boolean caffeine effect itself remains idempotent.
independent_review_findings.missing_proof: The exact number of world-entry cycles in a normal user session was not observed in game; two invocations are sufficient to reproduce the static wrapper chain.
independent_review_findings.recommended_correction: Install each wrapper once, preserve the true original once, and make repeated installation a no-op.
independent_review_findings.smallest_regression_test: Fire OnGameStart twice, perform one matching consumption action, and assert one original call and one trait effect.

independent_review_findings.title: Albino and Bad Teeth exclude each other without an inspected mechanical or design rationale
independent_review_findings.reproduction_evidence: The exclusion is reciprocal, but the traits have unrelated descriptions and runtime mechanics and are not paired in the inspected MET grouping source.
independent_review_findings.missing_proof: No user-approved design note, upstream source-mod record, or gameplay rationale for this exclusion was supplied.
independent_review_findings.recommended_correction: Document the intended incompatibility or remove both exclusion edges after an explicit design decision.
independent_review_findings.smallest_regression_test: Assert the approved exclusion graph and verify both character-creation selection orders.

independent_review_findings.title: Albino description promises physical harm but runtime only changes stress and fatigue
independent_review_findings.reproduction_evidence: The handler adds stress and fatigue and writes UT_albinoDamage, but no inspected consumer reads that field and no health or body-damage API is called.
independent_review_findings.missing_proof: No in-game trace could prove an undocumented consumer outside the closed-world source inventory.
independent_review_findings.recommended_correction: Implement the promised physical harm through a supported health/body-damage path or remove the claim.
independent_review_findings.smallest_regression_test: Expose the trait to daylight for one qualifying cadence and assert either a supported physical-damage change or a description that does not promise one.

independent_review_findings.smallest_regression_test: Create a character with the trait in the current game build and assert exactly one Electricity level/boost after creation and reload.

independent_review_findings.title: Food-timer polling misses ordinary partial meals
independent_review_findings.reproduction_evidence: The trait infers a meal only from healthFromFoodTimer rising by more than 50. The engine increments that timer only when eating reaches minimum hunger, resets it for dangerous uncooked food, and small increments also fail the threshold.
independent_review_findings.missing_proof: No in-game trace establishes that every intended meal reaches hunger zero and increments the timer by more than 50.
independent_review_findings.recommended_correction: Use the actual timed-action/Eat path through an idempotent shared hook, or explicitly narrow the description to fully satiating safe meals.
independent_review_findings.smallest_regression_test: Simulate a partial meal leaving hunger above zero, a fully satiating meal, an increment of exactly 50, and dangerous uncooked food; assert the approved trigger contract.

independent_review_findings.title: Antique cannot reach its reward logic under the current inventory refresh event contract
independent_review_findings.reproduction_evidence: The event emits (self,state), but the callback expects a third player argument and exits on nil. It also treats self.backpacks, a Lua table, as a Java list with size/get.
independent_review_findings.missing_proof: No alternate event emitter with the expected three-argument/Java-list shape exists in the current indexed PZCodebase.
independent_review_findings.recommended_correction: Accept (inventoryPage,state), resolve the player from the page/current player, and iterate backpacks with ipairs/#.
independent_review_findings.smallest_regression_test: Trigger OnRefreshInventoryWindowContainers with the exact engine arguments and a Lua-table backpacks fixture; assert one qualifying reward path.

independent_review_findings.title: Ascetic adds 5 to a 0..1 stress stat and clamps immediately to maximum
independent_review_findings.reproduction_evidence: On the qualifying path Stats.add(STRESS,5) delegates to clamping set(), so any normal stress value becomes 1.0.
independent_review_findings.missing_proof: The intended normalized magnitude is not documented.
independent_review_findings.recommended_correction: Choose a normalized delta consistent with the intended UI magnitude and encode it explicitly.
independent_review_findings.smallest_regression_test: Start at stress 0.2, trigger once with an engine-faithful clamping mock, and assert the approved non-saturating result.

independent_review_findings.title: Food-timer edge detection runs every OnPlayerUpdate
independent_review_findings.reproduction_evidence: registerTickHandler is called without throttle; the dispatcher defaults the omitted throttle to zero and executes the polling handler on every player update.
independent_review_findings.missing_proof: No in-game profiler capture quantifies the cost, but the unbounded cadence is statically proven and contradicts the same campaign's Anorexy classification.
independent_review_findings.recommended_correction: Move meal detection to an exact consumption edge or apply a documented bounded throttle.
independent_review_findings.smallest_regression_test: Count executions over 300 player updates and assert the approved upper bound.

independent_review_findings.reproduction_evidence: The trait caches the sharpness-adjusted getter as an absolute base, writes raw critical chance, and has no reliable drop/transfer/trait-loss restoration. It also competes with Action Hero on the same item.
independent_review_findings.missing_proof: Independent persistence of the raw Java field across save/load was not observed; same-world handoff is sufficient to prove the leak.
independent_review_findings.recommended_correction: Use a shared aggregate modifier and restore on every ownership/equipment/trait transition.
independent_review_findings.smallest_regression_test: Apply Axes to a non-unit-sharpness weapon, transfer it to a non-trait player, and assert the original raw critical chance.

independent_review_findings.title: Backpacker recomputes aggregate carry state every OnPlayerUpdate

independent_review_findings.recommended_correction: Refresh on lifecycle/strength changes or a bounded documented cadence.
independent_review_findings.smallest_regression_test: Count aggregate recomputations over 300 updates and assert the approved maximum.

independent_review_findings.smallest_regression_test: Compare the exact source/release block and validate every XPBoost token against current PerkFactory.Perks.

independent_review_findings.smallest_regression_test: Apply with two items, remove one, run the next cadence, and assert the remaining/removed items are restored; separately test a one-item outfit.

independent_review_findings.smallest_regression_test: Create a trait holder and assert a supported hit/accuracy calculation changes; fail if only modData changes.

independent_review_findings.title: Glass Body reads health before the current weapon damage is applied
independent_review_findings.reproduction_evidence: Even with corrected callback parameters, OnWeaponHitCharacter fires before processHitDamage/hitConsequences. Current health is unchanged, so the hook returns or misattributes an earlier between-tick loss; falls do not emit this weapon event.
independent_review_findings.recommended_correction: Use a supported post-damage/deferred delta path or modify damage through a valid pre-application hook.
independent_review_findings.smallest_regression_test: Model exact engine order: fire event, then apply base damage; assert the corrected implementation multiplies only the current resolved hit and separately handles falls if promised.

independent_review_findings.title: Independent critical-chance writers are non-composable and use mismatched effective/raw domains
independent_review_findings.reproduction_evidence: Each trait caches and writes an absolute critical chance on the same weapon. HandWeapon.getCriticalChance returns raw multiplied by sharpness while setCriticalChance writes raw; combined traits overwrite rather than compose and item transitions can strand a bonus.
independent_review_findings.missing_proof: The raw Java field's independent save/load persistence was not observed; same-world composition and handoff defects are statically proven.
independent_review_findings.recommended_correction: Use one raw-domain-safe per-source aggregate or calculate bonuses at hit time, with complete swap/drop/transfer/trait-loss restoration.
independent_review_findings.smallest_regression_test: Use a non-unit-sharpness weapon with Action Hero plus Axes or Cleaver, toggle both effects, transfer the item, and assert additive composition and exact base restoration.

independent_review_findings.title: Shared food-timer polling does not represent ordinary meals and is inconsistently throttled
independent_review_findings.reproduction_evidence: healthFromFoodTimer rises only when eating reaches minimum hunger and can reset for dangerous uncooked food; ordinary partial meals and increments of 50 or less are missed. Equivalent polling paths were classified inconsistently across batches.
independent_review_findings.missing_proof: No current-game meal trace establishes that every intended meal reaches hunger zero and raises the timer by more than 50.
independent_review_findings.recommended_correction: Use an idempotent exact consumption edge or narrow the descriptions; apply a documented bounded cadence wherever polling remains.
independent_review_findings.smallest_regression_test: Exercise partial, fully satiating, exactly-50, and dangerous-uncooked meals while counting handler calls over a fixed update window.

independent_review_findings.title: Directional and undocumented exclusions contradict accepted reciprocal-coverage claims
independent_review_findings.reproduction_evidence: Current selection checks are directional. Competitive Eater names Gourmand without the reverse edge; several custom traits name vanilla opposites without proven reverse edges; Albino/Bad Teeth is reciprocal but lacks inspected rationale; Couch Dweller's alleged opponent has no authoritative source.
independent_review_findings.missing_proof: No user-approved design record resolves the undocumented Albino/Bad Teeth edge or identifies Couch Dweller's alleged opposing trait.
independent_review_findings.recommended_correction: Reject B03-UT_couchdweller-01, make intended incompatibilities explicit in both selection directions, and document or remove unexplained edges.
independent_review_findings.smallest_regression_test: Validate the approved exclusion graph and attempt every affected pair in both character-creation selection orders.

independent_review_findings.title: Food traits mutate transferable item state and Gordanite double-counts its calorie bonus
independent_review_findings.reproduction_evidence: Both traits mutate shared food objects. Gordanite changes item calories to 1.5x before vanilla Eat and then adds half of the already-modified value, yielding 2.25x base calories; transfer exposes mutations to other owners.
independent_review_findings.missing_proof: Save/load persistence was not observed; same-world transfer and the 2.25x arithmetic are proven from current source and engine order.
independent_review_findings.recommended_correction: Calculate approved effects at consumption time without persistent shared-item mutation and restore or migrate existing cached state safely.
independent_review_findings.smallest_regression_test: Consume a 200-calorie item through the full vanilla-plus-hook path and assert 300 total, then transfer inspected Gordanite/Gourmand food to a non-trait player and assert base values.

independent_review_findings.title: Shared timed-action wrappers stack across repeated world entries
independent_review_findings.reproduction_evidence: Every OnGameStart captures the current perform method and wraps it again without a sentinel. A second entry chains two wrappers, repeating Allergic, Antivaxxer, and Gordanite effects; Caffeine still traverses redundant layers.
independent_review_findings.missing_proof: The distribution of repeated world entries in ordinary play was not measured; two installer calls deterministically reproduce the chain.
independent_review_findings.recommended_correction: Install each wrapper once, retain the true original once, and make repeated installation a no-op.
independent_review_findings.smallest_regression_test: Fire OnGameStart twice, perform one matching action, and assert one original invocation and one trait effect.

independent_review_findings.title: Mocks erase engine stat clamps and HandWeapon getter/setter domain differences
independent_review_findings.reproduction_evidence: Mock Stats set/add/remove do not clamp and mock critical chance uses one raw scalar. Current engine clamps normalized stats and returns sharpness-adjusted critical chance while setting raw chance, so passing mock tests mask confirmed numerical defects.
independent_review_findings.missing_proof: No Kahlua/in-game boundary test currently supplements these simplified mocks.
independent_review_findings.recommended_correction: Make exact mocks engine-faithful for these domains and add negative boundary/order fixtures.
independent_review_findings.smallest_regression_test: Assert stress/hunger clamping and non-unit-sharpness critical apply/restore against fixtures matching current engine source.

independent_review_findings.title: Brittle and Glass Body rely on a weapon event that fires before damage resolution
independent_review_findings.reproduction_evidence: OnWeaponHitCharacter fires before avoid/no-damage checks and before processHitDamage. Brittle can roll on a zero/cancelled contact; Glass Body reads pre-hit health and therefore misses or misattributes the current loss.
independent_review_findings.missing_proof: No supported post-resolution hook was identified in the assigned implementation; falls also do not emit this weapon event.
independent_review_findings.recommended_correction: Require positive resolved damage for Brittle and redesign Glass Body around a supported post-damage/deferred delta or valid pre-application hook.
independent_review_findings.smallest_regression_test: Model exact engine order for a cancelled hit, a positive hit, and a fall; assert only intended resolved damage is modified.

independent_review_findings.title: Exact assigned source and release surfaces drift for Antique and both Bouncer definitions
independent_review_findings.reproduction_evidence: Antique uses different container-add calls across source/release. The only exact-68 definition block drift is Bouncer I/II: source Doctor=1/2 versus release FirstAid=1/2, while current PerkFactory exposes Doctor and not FirstAid.
independent_review_findings.missing_proof: No deployed/live copy was inspected because deployment surfaces were outside scope.
independent_review_findings.recommended_correction: After separate authorization, synchronize release from current canonical source and validate every XPBoost token against current PerkFactory.Perks.
independent_review_findings.smallest_regression_test: Compare every assigned source/release definition and runtime file byte-for-byte and reject unknown XPBoost tokens.
